title: BNPL Diamond: Eligibility Segments and Minimum Spend Requirements Explained
summary: Explains BNPL Diamond eligibility for customers in the HIGH_SPEND_RETAIL segment and sets a minimum average monthly spend requirement of at least $502500.00 over the evaluation period. Average is calculated from settled transactions, with reversals/refunds/chargebacks reducing the average.
